newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate ends down from high prior close.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate ends down from high prior close.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates ended 250 basis points down at 17.50 percent on Wednesday after rising late Tuesday in speculative trading.
Dealers said speculation and month-end liquidity pressures prevented rates from falling further.
"At this time of the month you get players who are either short on liquidity or paper and the tug-of-war between them makes the market volatile," a fixed-income analysts said.
Banco de Mexico drained 898 million pesos from the market by placing three direct Cetes sales and two repos.
Overnight rates on bank paper meanwhile closed down 50 basis points at 20.00 percent.
Liquidity of 1.872 billion pesos was scheduled to return to the system on Friday from prior central bank participation.
